blocks.text: Group 2 ke anasir, beryllium, magnesium, calcium, strontium, barium aur radium, s-block anasir hain. Inhein alkaline earth metals kehte hain kyunke yeh dhaatein hain aur zameen ki parat mein milte hain, aur in ki reactivity bohat reactive alkali metals aur kam reactive transition metals ke darmiyan hai. Calcium aur magnesium zameen ki parat ke aath sab se zyada paye jane wale anasir mein hain.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Beryllium aerospace ke liye tambe ki mixed dhaaton ko sakht banane mein, magnesium chlorophyll ka hissa hai, aur magnesium, calcium, strontium aur barium aatish baazi ko chamakdar rang dete hain.

Group 2 ke sab anasir ke bairooni s subshell mein do electrons (ns2) hain, is liye un ki kimiyai khasiyatein milti julti hain, lekin khasiyatein group mein neeche ba-qaida badalti hain. Pighalne ke darje aur kasafat ke rujhan dhaat ke atoms ki mukhtalif tarteeb (packing) par munhasir hain.

blocks.prompt: Group 2 ke kis unsar ki pehli ionization energy sab se zyada hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Beryllium (900 kJ/mol): is ke bairooni electrons nucleus ke sab se qareeb aur sab se kam shielded hain.

items: Group 2: alkaline earth metals, configuration ns2.
Group mein neeche: radius barhta, ionization energy aur electronegativity ghat'ti.
